requirement.normalizedRequirement: The maximum and minimum ice class draughts at fore and aft perpendiculars shall be determined in accordance with the upper and lower ice waterlines and the draught of the ship at fore and aft perpendiculars, when ice conditions require the ship to be ice-strengthened, shall always be between the upper and lower ice waterlines.
requirement.section: Maximum and minimum draught fore and aft
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
